desc: Group the requests by endpoint. For each endpoint, in order of its first appearance, return (endpoint, count, p90, errors): count is its number of requests; p90 is the nearest-rank 90th percentile of its ms values, i.e. the k-th smallest value (1-based, duplicates counted) where k = ceil(0.9 * count), which in integer arithmetic is (9 * count + 9) / 10 rounded down; errors is the number of its requests with status 500 or above.

decls.ts: type Request = { endpoint: string; ms: number; status: number };
